verdict.rationale: Vanta markets a built-in Vanta AI Agent that works across the platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues. Vanta AI also reviews evidence and suggests fixes, and a TPRM Agent handles vendor discovery and assessments, so delegating tasks to an in-product assistant is clearly the offering. The evidence is marketing-level only. The MCP server serves external assistants, so it is not credited here as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how users assign or delegate tasks to the agent (interface, scope, approvals), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent works as claimed.
